verdict.rationale: Paxos documents that a business can hold stablecoin balances on the platform: payments can be held in stablecoin rather than auto-converted, USD can be minted into and redeemed from stablecoins, and institutions are onboarded via the Identity API. Gating appears only implicitly, as an onboarding decision for institution identities, and the pack never states where or to whom custodial accounts are available. missing for 10: stated geographic availability and eligibility, explicit description of custodial account terms and gating (e.g., enterprise-only or sales-gated access), independent corroboration of holding balances in production.
